Admin.title: Admin
Admin.universitiesSlugHint: URL-friendly identifier. Leave empty to auto-generate from the name.
Admin.universitiesRankingHint: Optional JSON, e.g. {"qs": 244}. Never invent rankings — leave empty when unavailable.
Admin.universitiesDeleteConfirm: Delete this university? Its programmes will be deleted too.
Admin.facultiesDeleteConfirm: Delete this faculty? Linked programmes will no longer show a faculty.
Admin.qualificationsDeleteConfirm: Delete this qualification? Programmes and profiles referencing it will lose the link.
Admin.programmesTuitionHint: Overall annual tuition range in one currency; use the per-option section below for specialization details.
Admin.programmesTuitionVariantsHint: Optional per-specialization prices. Period per option: per year, per semester, or total for the whole course.
Admin.programmesLanguageRequirementsHint: One per line: TEST:minScore:display — e.g. IELTS:6.5:IELTS 6.5 or CEFR:4:B2
Admin.requirementsTestRequirementsHint: Structured rows: qualification, section/subject, minimum score and comparison. Empty minimum score = accepted with no threshold.
Admin.requirementsDescription: Programmes and the completeness of their structured admission requirements.
Admin.sourcesDescription: Official/public sources backing catalog facts. Never invent URLs — use real public pages.
Admin.importsDescription: Ingest programme/university data from a file: parse, validate, then insert with errors captured for review.
Admin.importsJsonHint: JSON: array of objects. Each object must have university_name, name, degree_level, field_name, language_code, duration_months, tuition_min, tuition_currency (tuition_max optional).
Admin.importsCsvHint: CSV: same columns in the header row, one programme per line.
Admin.importsNoErrors: No errors recorded for this import.
Admin.settingsGrantHint: Paste a Supabase user UUID (anonymous sessions get one automatically). Access is immediate via RLS.
